title: Pet Acceptance and Pet Fee Schedule (Guest Folios, Ashbury Brands)
content:
Whether a brand accepts pets other than service animals, and what it charges to the Guest Folio for them, is fixed per brand: a non-refundable pet cleaning fee per stay, a higher fee for stays of the extended-stay threshold or more, the threshold itself in nights, the maximum weight of an accepted pet, the maximum number of pets per room, whether the fee is refunded when no cleaning is needed, and whether service animals are exempt from pet fees and pet limits.

## Schedule

| Brand | Pets accepted | Pet fee per stay (shorter stays) | Pet fee per stay (extended stays) | Extended-stay threshold | Maximum pet weight | Maximum pets per room | Fee refunded when no cleaning is needed | Service animals exempt |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | Yes | $75.00 | $150.00 | 7 nights | 40 lb | 2 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | Yes | $100.00 | $150.00 | 7 nights | 50 lb | 2 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Hotel | Yes | $100.00 | $175.00 | 7 nights | 50 lb | 2 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Grand | Yes | $150.00 | $200.00 | 7 nights | 40 lb | 2 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | 7 nights | 0 lb | 0 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Reserve | Yes | $200.00 | $300.00 | 7 nights | 50 lb | 2 | No | Yes |

The shorter-stay fee applies to stays shorter than the extended-stay threshold; the extended-stay fee applies to stays of that many nights or more. Ashbury Resort & Spa does not accept pets other than service animals, which is why its weight and per-room limits read 0.

## Which fee a stay carries: boundary cases (hypothetical stays)

| Hypothetical stay | Nights against the 7-night threshold | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Hotel, 6 nights | Shorter than 7 | $100.00 |
| Ashbury Hotel, 7 nights | Exactly 7, so at the threshold | $175.00 |
| Ashbury Reserve, 10 nights | More than 7 | $300.00 |
| Ashbury Express, 2 nights | Shorter than 7 | $75.00 |

**Is the pet fee given back if the room needs no cleaning?** No; at every brand the pet fee is not refundable.

**Are service animals charged?** No; at every brand service animals are exempt from pet fees and pet limits.
